rows.description: The total count of orders placed across all restaurants, indicating overall platform activity.
Sum of all order item prices multiplied by quantity, representing the total earnings generated.
Average monetary value per order, calculated as total revenue divided by total orders, showing typical spend.
Percentage of orders delivered on time (status = 'Delivered') versus total delivered orders, measuring delivery performance.
Number of new customers who signed up within the last month, reflecting growth in the user base.
Mean rating of restaurants based on the rating column, indicating overall customer satisfaction.
